locations.name: Materials Yard
locations.apprentice: Gain 2 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood.
locations.shifu: Gain 3 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood.

locations.name: Forming Studio
locations.apprentice: Pay the normal Clay cost to shape 1 vessel of any Shape.
locations.shifu: Pay the normal Clay costs to shape up to 2 vessels of any Shapes.

locations.name: Glaze Workshop
locations.apprentice: Apply 1 Glaze and choose 1 Decoration for 1 shaped ceramic. Pay the Decoration cost normally.
locations.shifu: Choose one: apply Glaze and Decoration to up to 2 shaped ceramics, paying costs normally; or apply Glaze and Decoration to 1 shaped ceramic and ignore that Decoration's Coin cost.

locations.name: Kiln Yard
locations.apprentice: Gain 1 Wood, then load 1 glazed ceramic into any empty kiln space.
locations.shifu: Gain 1 Wood, then load up to 2 glazed ceramics into any empty kiln spaces.
clarifications: Gaining Wood is optional and occurs before loading.
A player may take the Wood without loading.
The Shifu does not reposition ceramics.

locations.name: Market & Imperial Office
locations.apprentice: Choose one: take 1 face-up Market or Imperial Order; or gain 2 Coins. In addition, you may sell 1 Flawed ceramic for 1 Coin.
locations.shifu: Choose one: take up to 2 face-up Orders; take 1 face-up Order and gain 2 Coins; or gain 4 Coins. In addition, you may sell up to 2 Flawed ceramics for 1 Coin each.
locations.clarification: Selling Flawed ceramics is an optional secondary effect resolved after the main Office action, not a main action choice.

locations.name: Guild & Academy
locations.restriction: Only a Shifu may be placed at this location.
locations.shifu: Before choosing, you may return 1 face-up Technique to the bottom of its discipline deck and reveal a replacement. Then pay the printed Coin cost and take 1 face-up Technique.
